title: Odile and the Debt
author: Wren Thackeray
blurb: Ansel Vane, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
